question: Which of the following ingredients is used as an anti-wear additive in lubricating oil?
solution:
__**Explanation:**__

**Anti-Wear Additives in Lubricating Oil**

 
• Anti-wear additives are compounds used in lubricating oils to protect metal surfaces from wear under high-pressure conditions. These additives form a protective layer on the metal surface, reducing friction and wear and enhancing the operational life of machinery components.
 
• Anti-wear additives work by undergoing a chemical reaction under high pressure and heat. When the lubricant is exposed to extreme conditions, these additives react with the metal surfaces to form a protective film or coating. This film minimizes direct metal-to-metal contact, reducing wear and tear on the components.

**Importance:**

 
• They ensure the longevity and reliability of machinery by reducing wear on moving parts.
 
• Anti-wear additives improve the efficiency and performance of the lubricant, allowing machinery to operate smoothly under severe conditions.
 
• They are especially crucial in high-load and high-speed applications, such as automotive engines, industrial machines, and heavy equipment.

**Correct Option Analysis:**
